text:
Zoe L: Prep note for Meridian pilot. They require streaming + function/tool calls that emit strict JSON objects (server validates against schema), EU data residency, CMK KMS, and a procurement-friendly pricing anchor for ~20 concurrent streams at ~3k tokens per request.

Kiran M: I'll own pricing. Need a short, copy-pasteable line for the procurement doc and a recommended Dedicated sizing with burst plan.

Devon (SE): Integration summary: our streaming websocket sends delta events. Default SDK waits for function_call.complete, but set options.partial_tool_payload=true to receive incremental args. Minimal Node example:```js
ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'start', model:'redwood-stream-1', options:{partial_tool_payload:true}}));
ws.on('message', m=>console.log(JSON.parse(m)));```

Devon (SE): For strict JSON outputs we recommend using function-calls + a json-schema registered in the request. SDK includes a small incremental validator that runs on deltas. If Meridian wants to act on partials, enable partial_tool_payload and perform progressive validation.

Maya P: Security Qs: I'll draft the answers for data location and KMS. Do we have a one-liner for Dedicated vs Private we can paste?

Devon (SE): One-liner: "Dedicated hosts inference in a reserved Redwood cluster in the requested cloud region (we can reserve EU-only capacity); Private deploys into the customer's VPC/air-gapped environment so inference payloads and model artifacts do not leave the customer's network."

Maya P: I'll expand with CMK wording: "We support customer-managed keys via major cloud KMS providers and on-prem HSM. Audit artifacts (SOC2/ISO) available under NDA; telemetry retention configurable."

Kiran M: Pricing anchor draft for procurement: "1-month Dedicated pilot: 30% pilot credit applied to the first month (up to 200 GPU-hours). Reserved capacity to support 20 concurrent 3k-token streams; autoscale configured to handle spikes to 40. Overage billed at standard Dedicated rates. Subject to legal." Copyable?

Zoe L: Perfect — Meridian wants to start with a 2-week POC then expand. Action items: (1) Maya post final questionnaire text, (2) Devon share short Go snippet + perf note, (3) Kiran finalize the anchor and loop finance, (4) schedule 30-min kickoff Tue 10am CET.

Devon (SE): Go snippet (tiny):```go
// partial payload flag example
conn.Write(JSON.Marshal(map[string]interface{}{"type":"start","model":"redwood-stream-1","options":map[string]bool{"partial_tool_payload":true}}))
// handle incoming deltas and assemble partial args client-side
```

Devon (SE): Perf note: first partials typically arrive in ~40-200ms; for long streams expect steady delta cadence (~150-400ms). Partial mode adds small CPU overhead for reassembly/validation. Recommend a 2-hour 20x3k load run to confirm GPU-hours.

InfraBot: Runbook created: runbook://meridian-poc-2938475600 (access: sales,se,security,infra).

Maya P: I'll post the questionnaire answers and SOC2 link here when infra confirms region options.

Kiran M: I'll draft the final anchor and send to Finance. If infra requires EU warm-pool lead time, flag here.

Zoe L: Thanks team — I'll send the invite and include this thread in the kickoff packet. :thumbsup:
